paragraphs: (Tuviah, Zechariah 6:14.) Rav Zutra bar Tuviah: Berakhot 7a.

notes.text: The reviewed Zechariah 6:14, Berakhot 7a and Sanhedrin 52b passages support the separate name notices; the Sanhedrin digital title Rav appears parenthetically. Rabbah bar Tuviah bar Yitzchak is positively named in Eruvin 28b, while Hyman supplies 28a and omits the further patronymic. These are separate attestations, not a merged family identity.
